title: Hoshino Ichika — New Beginnings〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Morning, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Morning, Ichi♪

rows.Speaker: Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Morning.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Before we start our practice, I want to go over the stuff that came up during practice yesterday and some other things for us all to keep in mind. Let me know once you guys are all set up.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (That means I get to use the notebook I got for band practices right away.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Ichi, you got a new notebook...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My old one only had a few pages left, so I decided to get a new one while I was out shopping for school notebooks.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Cool.
It's like you're getting a fresh new start!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was also sorting through all of my old notebooks and realized that I have a big pile of them for lyrics and practices now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Which raised a question.
How long do I keep them?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Dunno...
Everyone takes notes in different ways.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My notes from when we just got our band back together are all about the basics, which probably won't help us now... Maybe I should get rid of them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What, like throw them out?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm holding onto mine forever♪
They're basically the same as old diaries!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, since we have been practicing just about every day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, exactly!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Plus, after we've debuted as pros, you could present them on TV as a piece of our past♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think you're getting a little ahead of yourself there.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? There's also all the audio we recorded of us practicing. I'm starting to wonder what we should do about that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... Right, I haven't been deleting those. I'll probably run out of space soon.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I get videos, but I didn't realize how much space sound files could take up! Still, I wanna keep as many as I can...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You could move them somewhere else.
I've heard of services that provide backup data storage.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I might have to do that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
What about you, Shiho?
Do you save all your notebooks and recordings and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I keep my notebooks.
They remind me to not forget about my roots.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I usually delete audio files when I feel that we've become good enough.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Is it that surprising?
They keep piling up basically every day, so I need to do something about them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's like you not to stress over that sort of thing, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, then! Hona, what about you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I still have all of my notebooks too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As far as audio recordings go, I try to keep the most memorable ones, like of our rehearsals the day before shows and such.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That makes sense...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks for taking the time to discuss this.
In that case, I'll hang onto my notebooks for a little while longer.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But that leaves the sound files...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I dunno what to do either. I mean, there's something special about how we play in the heat of the moment that makes each performance unique.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Then, I say just leave them.
If you delete them and end up regretting it down the road, it'll be too late.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We can't really play the way we used to because of how much we've improved.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
She's right.
We sound like a completely different band compared to when we first got back together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When we first got back together...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then, I think I'll keep our very first recording alongside our best ones.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Whenever I'm feeling down, I can cheer myself up by taking a listen, looking back and seeing just how far we've come.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that's a great idea!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, I'll save all of our recordings on behalf of our band!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We can even turn it into a quiz down the road! Question! What song were we practicing in this recording, and around when was it taken?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're joking, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That sounds like fun, but I'm not sure if I'll get the right answer.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Anyway, are you all ready?
We still need to talk about the stuff that came up yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm ready.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Same here♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, let's get started.

rows.Speaker: Saki, Ichika & Honami
rows.Line:
Okay♪
Sure.
